Stainless steel.rationale: 304 flat rolled coil is a possible feedstock proxy. BOM specifies neither alloy nor product form. Dataset already includes steelmaking and rolling; kettle component forming remains unknown. No impact factor accepted.
Stainless steel.alternatives: 8560388b-7ea1-38b7-befc-fd25d5deb450 (quarto plate, alternative form); 34897ebd-aa3d-347c-91ee-876c3f835fdb (scrap, not finished steel)

Brass.rationale: No brass process name found in complete archive scan. Copper plus zinc would require a documented alloy composition, alloying energy and suppliers; none supplied.
Brass.alternatives: Copper and zinc keyword results are upstream ingredients, not a brass alloy inventory.

Copper.rationale: Bridge converts 1 kg regional-storage copper to 9.13 USD (2012 producer price) of Copper, gold and silver concentrates. This broad mining-sector bridge is not a physical refined-copper LCI factor; USEEIO supplier and price/sector relevance require review.
Copper.alternatives: f0810c41-81cd-3dea-83b2-7a66c7fd9362 is copper sulfate, not copper metal.

Polypropylene (PP).rationale: Virgin PP resin matches polymer but recycled content, additives and molding are unknown. Resin is gate-to-gate and requires upstream links. No impact factor accepted.
Polypropylene (PP).alternatives: 185648c2-334e-419c-bf16-bb95e258f6bb (recycled PP, recycled share unknown); 89a2b59a-1ca2-34f5-acc8-a8eaaa6fa870 (molded PP product already includes 1.034 kg resin, 6.444 MJ electricity and 0.1 kg corrugated packaging per 1 kg part; do not add full resin burden again)

Polyvinyl chloride (PVC).rationale: Suspension-grade PVC resin is a polymer candidate; plasticizers, compounding and component forming are not known. Dataset includes incoming transport within its own resin boundary, which must not be counted again.
Polyvinyl chloride (PVC).alternatives: PVC landfill dataset excluded from factory-gate boundary; polyvinylfluoride is a different polymer.

Nylon, grade unspecified.rationale: Nylon 6 bridge is retained for inspection only; no nylon grade chosen. Both nylon 6 and nylon 66 bridge to a broad Plastics monetary sector. Grade, provider and proxy validity unresolved.
Nylon, grade unspecified.alternatives: 052c051b-b37f-4f00-9fe8-f5b2764b69c1 (Nylon 66 bridge); no physical nylon process found under nylon/polyamide names.

Polyoxymethylene (POM).rationale: No POM/polyoxymethylene/polyacetal process name found. Formaldehyde is a potential feedstock, not a complete polymer-production dataset.
Polyoxymethylene (POM).alternatives: No unrelated plastic or formaldehyde process accepted as a substitute.

Polycarbonate (PC).rationale: PC bridge converts 1 kg to 6.970610088 USD (2012 producer price) of Plastics. Broad monetary-sector substitution has not been validated, and external supplier inventory is absent.
Polycarbonate (PC).alternatives: No physical PC polymer-production process found by name in the pinned archive.

Acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS).rationale: ABS copolymer resin matches polymer class. Kettle-grade formulation and molding unknown. Explicit exchanges govern linking; description alone is not a cumulative emission factor.
Acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS).alternatives: Acrylonitrile monomer and PAN are not ABS resin.

Silicone.rationale: No silicone/siloxane production process name found. Silicone elastomer is not silicon metal or silica. Grade and curing process are unknown.
Silicone.alternatives: Silicon keyword matches excluded as a chemically different material.

LDPE packaging foil.rationale: LDPE virgin resin matches the named polymer but does not cover finished film extrusion and loss. No conversion burden accepted.
LDPE packaging foil.alternatives: 26f39b7c-389c-4903-8f09-6ef5e95876cc (LLDPE stretch film, different polymer and an embedded 2% loss assumption; not silently substituted)

Cardboard packaging.rationale: Average corrugated product is a conditional proxy because board construction and recycled share were not supplied. It already covers corrugator/sheet-plant activity; avoid adding the same conversion again.
Cardboard packaging.alternatives: 9c10be0f-e38e-4551-b8b5-eef65fa27dcc (100% recycled corrugated product); solid board would require a different selection.
